q:
साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 के विजेताओं के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: ममता कालिया ने 'जीते जी इलाहाबाद' के लिए हिंदी में साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 जीता।
कथन II: नवतेज सरना ने अंग्रेजी श्रेणी में साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 जीता।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are correct (दोनों कथन सही हैं): Mamta Kalia won the 2025 Sahitya Akademi Award in Hindi for 'Jeete Jee Allahabad', and former diplomat-author Navtej Sarna won it in English.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Sahitya Akademi was formally inaugurated on 12 March 1954 in New Delhi.
2. The first Sahitya Akademi Award in Hindi (1955) was given to Makhanlal Chaturvedi for 'Him Tarangini'.
3. Sahitya Akademi also confers the Yuva Puraskar and Bal Sahitya Puraskar annually.
qe:
Match the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 winners with their respective language categories:
Statement I: Mamta Kalia won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in Hindi for 'Jeete Jee Allahabad'.
Statement II: Navtej Sarna won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in English.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में, पेप्ट्रिस (Peptris) को मुख्य रूप से किस क्षेत्र में नवाचार को गति देने के लिए ₹86 करोड़ का सहयोग प्राप्त हुआ?
e:
Peptris received ₹86 crore support in October 2026 for AI-Based Drug Discovery (पेप्ट्रिस को AI-आधारित औषधि खोज के लिए ₹86 करोड़ का सहयोग मिला)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. IndiaAI Mission (approved in 2024) promotes indigenous AI compute infrastructure, datasets, and domain-specific AI applications in healthcare and agriculture.
2. CSIR (Council of Scientific and Industrial Research) and DBT actively collaborate with startups on affordable therapeutics.
3. AI-driven molecular docking significantly accelerates preclinical drug screening.
qe: In October 2026, Peptris received ₹86 crore support primarily to accelerate innovation in which sector?

q: ICAR–भारतीय कृषि जैव प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान (ICAR-IIAB), जहाँ अक्टूबर 2026 में नई सुविधाओं का उद्घाटन किया गया, भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e:
ICAR-IIAB is located in Ranchi, the capital of Jharkhand (ICAR-IIAB झारखंड की राजधानी राँची में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Jharkhand was carved out of Bihar on 15 November 2000 (birth anniversary of Birsa Munda — celebrated as Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas).
2. Central Tasar Research & Training Institute is also located in Ranchi.
3. ICAR-IARI (Pusa Institute) is in New Delhi, and ICAR-IIVR (Vegetable Research) is in Varanasi, UP.
qe: The ICAR–Indian Institute of Agricultural Biotechnology (ICAR-IIAB), where new facilities were inaugurated in October 2026, is located in which Indian state?

q: नवंबर 2026 में उद्धृत आंकड़ों के अनुसार, कुल मछली और जलीय कृषि (aquaculture) उत्पादन में भारत का विश्व में कौन-सा स्थान है?
e:
India is the world's 2nd largest fish and aquaculture producer (after China) (भारत विश्व का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा मछली एवं जलीय कृषि उत्पादक देश है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. MPEDA (Marine Products Export Development Authority, est. 1972, HQ Kochi) promotes marine exports, while APEDA (est. 1986, HQ New Delhi) promotes agricultural & processed food exports.
2. Inland fisheries and aquaculture account for the majority of India's fish output, led by Andhra Pradesh.
3. 'Blue Revolution' (नीली क्रांति) is associated with fisheries development.
qe: What is India's global rank in total fish and aquaculture production as highlighted in November 2026?

q: ब्रह्मोस मिसाइल प्रणाली के लिए अक्टूबर 2026 में हस्ताक्षरित ₹661.50 करोड़ का रक्षा अनुबंध विशेष रूप से भारतीय सशस्त्र बलों की किस शाखा के लिए किया गया था?
e:
The ₹661.50 crore contract signed in October 2026 pertains to the Indian Navy's BrahMos missile system (यह ₹661.50 करोड़ का अनुबंध भारतीय नौसेना की ब्रह्मोस प्रणाली के लिए किया गया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Indian Navy Day is celebrated on 4 December (commemorating Operation Trident, 1971).
2. BrahMos flies at supersonic speeds of approximately Mach 2.8–3.0.
3. INS Vikrant (IAC-1) is India's first indigenously built aircraft carrier.
qe: The ₹661.50 crore defence contract signed in October 2026 for the BrahMos missile system was specifically inked for which branch of the Indian Armed Forces?

q:
अक्टूबर 2026 में लद्दाख के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: लद्दाख के 28 स्थानों को सर्वे ऑफ इंडिया के मानचित्र पर आधिकारिक रूप से चिह्नित किया गया।
कथन II: लद्दाख में ₹3,350 करोड़ की 5 बुनियादी ढाँचा परियोजनाओं का उद्घाटन किया गया।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are verified October 2026 facts about Ladakh (दोनों कथन सत्य हैं): 28 locations were marked on the Survey of India map and 5 projects worth ₹3,350 crore were inaugurated.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Umling La Pass in Ladakh (19,024 ft) is the world's highest motorable road built by the Border Roads Organisation (BRO).
2. Pangong Tso and Tso Moriri (a Ramsar wetland) are famous high-altitude lakes of Ladakh.
3. Leh is situated on the banks of the Indus river.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Ladakh in October 2026:
Statement I: Twenty-eight (28) locations in Ladakh were officially marked on the Survey of India map.
Statement II: Five infrastructure projects worth ₹3,350 crore were inaugurated in Ladakh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा एक्सप्रेस-वे लखनऊ को पूर्वी उत्तर प्रदेश (पूर्वांचल) के गाजीपुर से जोड़ता है?
e:
The 340.8 km long 6-lane Purvanchal Expressway connects Chand Sarai (Lucknow) to Haidaria (Ghazipur) and includes an airstrip at Sultanpur for IAF aircraft (पूर्वांचल एक्सप्रेस-वे लखनऊ को गाजीपुर से जोड़ता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Bundelkhand Expressway (296 km) connects Chitrakoot to Etawah (Agra–Lucknow Expressway).
2. Ganga Expressway (~594 km) links Meerut to Prayagraj across 12 districts.
3. Uttar Pradesh is known as the 'Expressway State of India'.
qe: Which expressway in Uttar Pradesh connects Lucknow to Ghazipur across eastern UP (Purvanchal)?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा स्थान संत कबीर के निर्वाण स्थल के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है और जहाँ 'मगहर महोत्सव' आयोजित होता है?
e:
Maghar (in Sant Kabir Nagar district, UP) is the nirvana/samadhi site of Sant Kabir, where both a Hindu samadhi and a Muslim mazar stand side by side (मगहर संत कबीर का निर्वाण स्थल है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Rajapur (Chitrakoot) is traditionally associated with Goswami Tulsidas; Soron (Kasganj) is also claimed by some scholars.
2. Runkata (near Agra) / Sihi (Faridabad) is associated with Surdas; Kalpi (Jalaun) is famous for handmade paper and Birbal's birthplace.
3. Sant Kabir was born in Varanasi (Lahartara) and deliberately chose Maghar at the end of his life to challenge superstition.
qe: Which town in Uttar Pradesh is famous as the birthplace of Sant Kabir and also hosts the famous 'Maghar Mahotsav' at Kabir's nirvana site (in Sant Kabir Nagar district)?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश में 'कुंभ मेला' गंगा, यमुना और अदृश्य सरस्वती के पवित्र संगम (त्रिवेणी संगम) पर किस नगर में आयोजित होता है?
e:
Kumbh Mela (and Maha Kumbh / Magh Mela) is held at Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj (प्रयागराज में त्रिवेणी संगम पर कुंभ मेला आयोजित होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Kumbh Mela is rotated among four Indian sites: Prayagraj (Ganga-Yamuna-Saraswati), Haridwar (Ganga), Ujjain (Shipra), and Nashik (Godavari).
2. Kumbh Mela was inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2017.
3. Allahabad was officially renamed Prayagraj in October 2018.
qe: The 'Kumbh Mela' in Uttar Pradesh is held at the sacred confluence (Triveni Sangam) of the Ganga, Yamuna, and mythical Saraswati in which city?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा जिला नेपाल के साथ सीमा साझा नहीं करता है?
e:
Seven districts of UP share an international border (~579 km) with Nepal (west to east): Pilibhit, Lakhimpur Kheri, Bahraich, Shravasti, Balrampur, Siddharthnagar, and Maharajganj. Gorakhpur does NOT touch Nepal (गोरखपुर नेपाल की सीमा से नहीं लगता)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Sonbhadra is the only district in India that borders four states: Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Bihar.
2. Uttar Pradesh shares borders with 8 states + 1 Union Territory (Delhi) + 1 country (Nepal).
3. Saharanpur borders Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, and Haryana.
qe: Which of the following districts of Uttar Pradesh does NOT share a border with Nepal?

q: गुप्तकालीन प्रसिद्ध 'भीतरगाँव मंदिर' (5वीं शताब्दी ई.), जो भारत के सबसे प्राचीन ईंट निर्मित मंदिरों में से एक है, उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में स्थित है?
e:
Bhitargaon Brick Temple is located in Kanpur Dehat (Kanpur) district of UP and is a landmark of Gupta terracotta and brick architecture (भीतरगाँव मंदिर कानपुर देहात में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Dashavatara Temple (stone temple with Panchayatan style, Gupta period) is located at Deogarh in Lalitpur district, UP.
2. Atala Masjid and Shahi Bridge (Sharqi architecture) are located in Jaunpur (known as 'Shiraz-e-Hind').
3. Buland Darwaza and Panch Mahal are located at Fatehpur Sikri (Agra), a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
qe: The famous 'Bhitargaon Temple' (5th century CE), one of the oldest surviving brick temples of the Gupta period in India, is located in which district of Uttar Pradesh?

q: प्रसिद्ध देशभक्ति गीत 'वन्दे मातरम्' के रचयिता कौन थे, जो उपन्यास 'आनन्दमठ' (1882) में संकलित है?
e:
Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay wrote 'Vande Mataram' in Sanskritized Bengali in 'Anandamath' (1882), based on the Sanyasi Rebellion (वन्दे मातरम् की रचना बंकिम चन्द्र चट्टोपाध्याय ने की)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. 'Vande Mataram' was first sung publicly at the 1896 Calcutta Session of the INC by Rabindranath Tagore.
2. It was adopted as India's National Song on 24 January 1950 (the same day 'Jana Gana Mana' was adopted as the National Anthem).
3. Rabindranath Tagore won Asia's first Nobel Prize in Literature (1913) for 'Gitanjali'.
qe: Who was the author of the famous Bengali patriotic song 'Vande Mataram', included in the novel 'Anandamath' (1882)?

q: 'पूना पैक्ट' (सितंबर 1932) महात्मा गांधी और डॉ. बी. आर. अम्बेडकर के बीच किस जेल में हस्ताक्षरित हुआ था?
e:
The Poona Pact (24 September 1932) was signed at Yerwada Central Jail in Pune, replacing separate electorates for Depressed Classes (under the Communal Award) with reserved seats in joint electorates (पूना पैक्ट पुणे की यरवदा जेल में हस्ताक्षरित हुआ)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Madan Mohan Malaviya signed the Poona Pact on behalf of Mahatma Gandhi (who was on fast unto death).
2. Reserved seats for Depressed Classes in provincial legislatures were raised from 71 to 147 (148).
3. Dr. B. R. Ambedkar attended all three Round Table Conferences (1930, 1931, 1932) in London.
qe: The 'Poona Pact' (September 1932) was signed between Mahatma Gandhi and Dr. B. R. Ambedkar at which prison?

q: किस मध्यकालीन शासक ने अपनी राजधानी दिल्ली से दौलताबाद (देवगिरि) स्थानांतरित की और सांकेतिक ताँबे की मुद्रा चलाई?
e:
Muhammad bin Tughlaq (reigned 1325–1351) is known for five ambitious but failed experiments including shifting capital to Daulatabad, token currency, and setting up Diwan-i-Amir-i-Kohi (agriculture department) (मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक ने राजधानी दौलताबाद स्थानांतरित की और सांकेतिक मुद्रा चलाई)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta (author of 'Rihla') visited India during Muhammad bin Tughlaq's reign and served as Qazi of Delhi.
2. Sikandar Lodi founded the city of Agra in 1504 and wrote Persian poetry under the pen name 'Gulrukhi'.
3. Alauddin Khalji introduced market control regulations, Dag (branding of horses), and Chehra (descriptive roll of soldiers).
qe: Which medieval ruler shifted his capital from Delhi to Daulatabad (Devagiri) and introduced token copper currency?

q: भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के निम्नलिखित समाचार पत्रों/पत्रिकाओं में से कौन-सा अपने संस्थापक/संपादक से सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e:
'Rast Goftar' (meaning 'Truth Teller', Gujarati fortnightly, 1851) was founded by Dadabhai Naoroji, NOT Gopal Krishna Gokhale (रास्त गोफ्तार के संस्थापक दादाभाई नौरोजी थे)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Dadabhai Naoroji ('Grand Old Man of India') also authored 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' (Drain of Wealth theory).
2. Gopal Krishna Gokhale founded the 'Servants of India Society' (1905) and published 'Sudharak' (with Agarkar).
3. Maulana Abul Kalam Azad was Independent India's first Education Minister (11 November is celebrated as National Education Day).
qe: Which of the following newspapers/journals of the Indian freedom struggle is NOT correctly matched with its founder/editor?

q: 'इल्बर्ट बिल विवाद' (1883) किस ब्रिटिश वायसराय के कार्यकाल के दौरान हुआ था?
e:
The Ilbert Bill (1883), drafted by Sir Courtenay Ilbert under Lord Ripon, sought to allow senior Indian magistrates to try European British subjects in criminal cases, sparking racial backlash from Europeans (इल्बर्ट बिल विवाद लॉर्ड रिपन के काल में हुआ)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Indian National Congress was founded in December 1885 during Lord Dufferin's tenure.
2. Lord Mayo initiated India's first non-synchronous census (1872), while Lord Ripon oversaw the first synchronous decennial census (1881).
3. The Ilbert Bill controversy unified educated Indians and hastened the formation of the INC.
qe: The 'Ilbert Bill Controversy' (1883) occurred during the tenure of which British Viceroy?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस भाग में राजभाषा (अनुच्छेद 343 से 351) से संबंधित प्रावधान निहित हैं?
e:
Part XVII (Articles 343–351) deals with Official Language (भाग 17 में राजभाषा से संबंधित प्रावधान हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Part XV (Arts. 324–329): Elections; Part XVI (Arts. 330–342): Special provisions relating to certain classes; Part XVIII (Arts. 352–360): Emergency Provisions.
2. Part XX (Article 368): Amendment of the Constitution.
3. First Official Language Commission (1955) was chaired by B. G. Kher.
qe: Which part of the Indian Constitution contains provisions relating to the Official Language (Articles 343 to 351)?

q: भारतीय स्कूली शिक्षा में 'त्रिभाषा सूत्र' (Three-Language Formula) को राष्ट्रव्यापी रूप से अपनाने की औपचारिक सिफारिश किस प्रमुख आयोग/नीति द्वारा की गई थी?
e:
The Kothari Commission (Education Commission, 1964–66) formulated the modified Three-Language Formula, which was formally adopted in the National Policy on Education (NPE) 1968 and reaffirmed in NEP 2020 (कोठारी आयोग और राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 1968 ने त्रिभाषा सूत्र की सिफारिश की)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Radhakrishnan Commission (1948–49) was the University Education Commission; Mudaliar Commission (1952–53) was the Secondary Education Commission.
2. Yashpal Committee (1993) submitted the famous report 'Learning Without Burden'.
3. Kothari Commission's report opened with the famous sentence: "The destiny of India is now being shaped in her classrooms."
qe: Under the Constitution of India, the 'Three-Language Formula' in school education was formally recommended for nationwide adoption by which landmark commission/policy?

q: अनुच्छेद 51A का कौन-सा मौलिक कर्तव्य माता-पिता या संरक्षक से 6 से 14 वर्ष की आयु के बच्चों को शिक्षा के अवसर प्रदान करने की अपेक्षा करता है?
e:
Article 51A(k) is the 11th Fundamental Duty, added by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002 (अनुच्छेद 51A(k) 11वाँ मौलिक कर्तव्य है जो 86वें संशोधन 2002 से जोड़ा गया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Originally 10 Fundamental Duties were added to Part IVA by the 42nd Amendment (1976) on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee.
2. Article 51A(g) relates to protecting the natural environment, forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife.
3. Fundamental Duties are borrowed from the Constitution of the former USSR and are non-justiciable by themselves.
qe: Which Fundamental Duty in Article 51A requires parents or guardians to provide opportunities for education to their child/ward between the ages of 6 and 14 years?

q:
भारत निर्वाचन आयोग (अनुच्छेद 324) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: मुख्य निर्वाचन आयुक्त (CEC) को उसी रीति से और उन्हीं आधारों पर पद से हटाया जा सकता है जिन पर सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश को हटाया जाता है।
कथन II: भारत निर्वाचन आयोग राज्यों में पंचायतों और नगरपालिकाओं के चुनाव आयोजित कराता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Statement I is correct (Article 324(5)). Statement II is incorrect because Panchayat and Municipal elections are conducted by the respective State Election Commissions under Articles 243K and 243ZA (पंचायत व नगरपालिका चुनाव राज्य निर्वाचन आयोग कराता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. ECI conducts elections for Parliament, State Legislatures, President, and Vice-President.
2. National Voters' Day is celebrated on 25 January (ECI was founded on 25 January 1950).
3. Voting age was lowered from 21 to 18 years by the 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Election Commission of India (Article 324):
Statement I: The Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) can be removed from office in the same manner and on the same grounds as a Judge of the Supreme Court.
Statement II: The Election Commission of India conducts elections to Panchayats and Municipalities in the states.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: जब संसद सत्र में न हो, तब भारत के राष्ट्रपति को अध्यादेश (Ordinance) जारी करने की शक्ति किस अनुच्छेद द्वारा प्रदान की गई है?
e:
Article 123 empowers the President to promulgate Ordinances during the recess of Parliament (maximum life without parliamentary approval is 6 months + 6 weeks) (अनुच्छेद 123 राष्ट्रपति को अध्यादेश जारी करने की शक्ति देता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Article 213 confers the corresponding ordinance-making power on State Governors.
2. Article 72 grants pardoning power to the President; Article 143 empowers the President to seek advisory opinion from the Supreme Court.
3. An ordinance must be approved by both Houses of Parliament within 6 weeks of reassembly.
qe: The power of the President of India to promulgate Ordinances when Parliament is not in session is conferred by which Article?

q: भारत में स्थित हिमालय की सबसे ऊँची पर्वत चोटी (सिक्किम में स्थित) कौन-सी है?
e:
Kanchenjunga (8,586 m, Sikkim–Nepal border) is the highest peak of the Himalayas in India and the third highest peak in the world (कंचनजंघा 8,586 मीटर विश्व की तीसरी और भारतीय हिमालय की सबसे ऊँची चोटी है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. K2 / Godwin-Austen (8,611 m, Karakoram range, PoK) is the highest peak in India's claimed territory.
2. Nanda Devi (7,816 m, Uttarakhand) is the highest peak lying entirely within Indian territory.
3. Anamudi (2,695 m, Kerala) is the highest peak in Peninsular India (Western Ghats).
qe: Which is the highest mountain peak located entirely within India (undisputedly in Sikkim on the India–Nepal border, highest peak of the Indian Himalayas)?

q: भारत के जनसांख्यिकीय अध्ययन में किस जनगणना वर्ष को 'महान विभाजक वर्ष' (Year of the Great Divide) कहा जाता है क्योंकि 1911–1921 के दशक में जनसंख्या वृद्धि दर ऋणात्मक रही थी?
e:
1921 is known as the 'Year of the Great Divide' (महान विभाजक वर्ष) because the 1911–21 decade saw a -0.31% decline due to the 1918 influenza pandemic and famines, after which India's population grew steadily every decade.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. 1951 is sometimes called the 'Year of Small Divide' (rapid decline in death rate leading to population explosion).
2. Highest decadal growth rate in independent India occurred during 1961–1971 (24.80%).
3. In Census 2011, Nagaland was the only state to record a negative decadal population growth rate (-0.58%).
qe: In demographic studies of India, which Census year is famously called the 'Year of the Great Divide' because India's population recorded a negative growth rate during the preceding decade (1911–1921)?

q: भारत की निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी झील जम्मू और कश्मीर में झेलम नदी से पोषित एक विवर्तनिक मीठे पानी की झील है तथा एशिया की सबसे बड़ी मीठे पानी की झीलों में से एक है?
e:
Wular Lake (Bandipora, J&K) is India's largest freshwater lake, formed by tectonic activity and fed by the Jhelum river (वुलर झील भारत की सबसे बड़ी मीठे पानी की झील है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Chilika Lake (Odisha) is India's largest brackish water lagoon and first Ramsar site (1981).
2. Sambhar Lake (Rajasthan) is India's largest inland salt lake.
3. Lonar Lake (Maharashtra) is a notified crater lake formed by a meteorite impact on basaltic rock.
qe: Which of the following lakes of India is a tectonic freshwater lake in Jammu & Kashmir fed by the Jhelum river, and is one of the largest freshwater lakes in Asia?

q: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था का कौन-सा क्षेत्र भारत के सकल मूल्य वर्धन (GVA) / GDP में सर्वाधिक योगदान देता है?
e:
The Tertiary (Services) sector contributes over 50% (~54–55%) of India's GVA, making it the largest contributor to GDP, while Agriculture employs the largest share of the workforce (सेवा क्षेत्र GDP में सर्वाधिक योगदान देता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Primary sector includes agriculture, forestry, fishing, and mining; Secondary sector includes manufacturing, electricity, gas, and construction.
2. Tertiary sector includes trade, transport, IT/software, banking, education, and health services.
3. Disguised unemployment (प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी) is most prevalent in India's agricultural sector.
qe: Which sector of the Indian economy contributes the largest share to India's Gross Value Added (GVA) / GDP?

q: भारत में प्रतिभूति और पूँजी बाजार (शेयर बाजार) के नियमन और विकास के लिए कौन-सा वित्तीय नियामक उत्तरदायी है?
e:
SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India), headquartered in Mumbai, was established in 1988 and given statutory powers via the SEBI Act, 1992 (SEBI भारत के पूँजी/शेयर बाजार का नियामक है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. IRDAI (HQ: Hyderabad) regulates the insurance sector; PFRDA (HQ: New Delhi) regulates pensions (NPS).
2. RBI (est. 1 April 1935 under RBI Act 1934, nationalized 1 Jan 1949) regulates banking and monetary policy.
3. BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange, est. 1875) is Asia's oldest stock exchange; its benchmark index is SENSEX (30 stocks), while NSE's index is NIFTY 50.
qe: Which financial regulator is responsible for regulating and developing the securities and capital markets (stock exchanges) in India?

q: जब सरकार अपने बजट घाटे की पूर्ति मुख्यतः घरेलू बाजार से भारी उधार लेकर करती है, जिससे ब्याज दरें बढ़ती हैं और निजी क्षेत्र का निवेश घटता है, तो इस घटना को क्या कहा जाता है?
e:
'Crowding-out effect' occurs when excessive public borrowing competes for loanable funds, driving up interest rates and squeezing out private investment (अत्यधिक सरकारी उधारी द्वारा निजी निवेश को कम करना क्राउडिंग-आउट प्रभाव कहलाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Liquidity trap (Keynes) occurs when interest rates are near zero and monetary policy loses effectiveness because people prefer holding cash.
2. FRBM Act (2003) aims to ensure fiscal discipline and reduce India's fiscal deficit.
3. Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit - Interest Payments.
qe: When a government finances its budget deficit primarily by borrowing heavily from the domestic market, thereby raising interest rates and reducing private-sector investment, the phenomenon is termed:

q: यूकैरियोटिक कोशिका के भीतर किस कोशिकांग को 'कोशिका का ऊर्जागृह' (Powerhouse of the Cell) कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह कोशिकीय श्वसन द्वारा ATP उत्पन्न करता है?
e:
Mitochondria generate ATP via oxidative phosphorylation (Krebs cycle + electron transport chain) and have their own circular DNA (माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया को कोशिका का पावरहाउस कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Ribosomes are 'Protein factories'; Lysosomes are 'Suicidal bags' (contain hydrolytic enzymes); Chloroplasts are 'Kitchen of plant cells'.
2. Both Mitochondria and Chloroplasts are semi-autonomous double-membrane organelles possessing their own DNA and 70S ribosomes.
3. Robert Hooke discovered cells (in cork) in 1665; Antonie van Leeuwenhoek first observed living cells.
qe: Which organelle inside a eukaryotic cell is known as the 'Powerhouse of the Cell' because it generates ATP through cellular respiration?

q: सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी में संक्षिप्त शब्द 'URL' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e:
URL stands for 'Uniform Resource Locator'—the standardized web address used to locate resources on the internet (URL का पूर्ण रूप 'Uniform Resource Locator' है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. HTTP = HyperText Transfer Protocol; HTTPS adds SSL/TLS encryption for secure communication.
2. HTML = HyperText Markup Language; CPU = Central Processing Unit; RAM = Random Access Memory (volatile).
3. Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web (WWW), HTTP, HTML, and URL at CERN in 1989.
qe: In information technology, what does the acronym 'URL' stand for?

q: निकट दृष्टि दोष (मायोपिया), जिसमें प्रतिबिम्ब रेटिना से पहले बनने के कारण दूर की वस्तुएँ धुँधली दिखाई देती हैं, के निवारण हेतु चश्मे में किस लेंस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e:
A Concave (diverging) lens of appropriate negative power diverges incoming parallel rays so that the image focuses sharply on the retina (निकट दृष्टि दोष के निवारण के लिए अवतल लेंस प्रयुक्त होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Hypermetropia (far-sightedness / दूर दृष्टि दोष) is corrected using a Convex (converging) lens.
2. Astigmatism (दृष्टिवैषम्य) is corrected using a Cylindrical lens; Presbyopia (जरा दूरदर्शिता) uses Bifocal lenses.
3. Power of a lens P = 1 / f (in metres), measured in Dioptre (D).
qe: Which lens is used in spectacles to correct Myopia (short-sightedness), where distant objects appear blurred because the image forms in front of the retina?
